Milestone Report: Workforce Reduction Notice

Regulatory Commissions • Zenith Governance Consulting • Pilot development review phase • 2016-10-28

Executive Summary

This archive entry documents ACPWB's pilot development review phase engagement with Zenith Governance Consulting in the Regulatory Commissions sector. Record ID 906d549e.

  • A review of Zenith Governance Consulting's clawback policy found it non-compliant with the final SEC rules under Dodd-Frank, requiring an update to cover a broader range of financial restatements and executive officers.
  • A review of Zenith Governance Consulting's pay-for-performance linkage found a weak correlation (r=0.2) between individual performance scores and merit increase percentages, undermining the credibility of the performance management system.
  • Our benchmarking of Zenith Governance Consulting's remote work policy found that its stipend of $251 per month is at the 95th percentile, but its policy on state tax withholding for remote employees is not fully compliant in 21 states.
  • Analysis of Zenith Governance Consulting's charitable giving program showed that only 8% of employees participate, with feedback indicating a desire for more direct involvement and matching gift opportunities.
  • Player payroll benchmarking against 147 comparable Regulatory Commissions sector organizations placed Zenith Governance Consulting at the 50th percentile of league spending intensity as of 2016-10-28, with luxury tax liability exceeding the median threshold by approximately 11%.
  • Analysis of Zenith Governance Consulting's job architecture identified 194 redundant levels and a span-of-control ratio of 8:1, which is below the Regulatory Commissions sector median of 6:1, suggesting opportunities for delayering and efficiency gains.
Key Findings
  • ACPWB's pilot development review conjoint analysis of 183 total rewards scenarios, administered to Zenith Governance Consulting employees in the Regulatory Commissions sector, finds that base salary accounts for 33% of employee preference weight — substantially below the 183% weight assigned by Zenith Governance Consulting's total rewards design team — with career development and flexible work arrangements more valued than the current program design reflects.
  • Labor cost benchmarking conducted during the pilot development review for Zenith Governance Consulting reveals that labor as a percentage of revenue is 66% above the Regulatory Commissions sector median across 11 comparable operating units, with the excess concentrated in management layers rather than hourly workforce costs — consistent with a span-of-control ratio of 66:1 against a market median of 11:1.
  • The pay equity regression analysis conducted for Zenith Governance Consulting during the pilot development review finds a residual gender pay gap of 275% after controlling for job grade, performance rating, tenure, and 35 additional explanatory variables — a gap that is statistically significant at p < 0.05 across 275 of the 35 Regulatory Commissions sector business units examined.
  • The ESG performance correlation study conducted for Zenith Governance Consulting during the pilot development review finds a 143% premium in three-year total shareholder return for Regulatory Commissions sector organizations in the top quartile of ACPWB's composite ESG score, with the relationship strongest among large-cap peers in 32 geographic markets.

ACPWB's engagement with Zenith Governance Consulting commenced in response to a competitive procurement process in which 24 firms submitted proposals. This archive entry captures the pilot development review deliverables that met or exceeded all specifications outlined in the original scope of work.

ACPWB's pilot development review nonprofit compensation benchmarking for Zenith Governance Consulting assessed pay competitiveness for 194 positions across program, development, finance, and executive leadership against Regulatory Commissions sector peers. The engagement produced a compensation philosophy and updated salary ranges reviewed by Zenith Governance Consulting's board compensation committee across 43 metropolitan service areas on 2016-10-28.

This archive entry reflects findings from a joint research initiative co-sponsored by Zenith Governance Consulting and 21 peer organizations operating in the Regulatory Commissions sector. The collaborative structure enabled a sample size of 120 that exceeds the threshold for publication in ACPWB's peer-reviewed research series.

The pilot development review of the Zenith Governance Consulting engagement focused on succession planning for the board of directors. This record from 2016-10-28 contains the skills matrix and the list of 145 potential director candidates reviewed by the nominating committee.

ACPWB's proprietary Regulatory Commissions sector maturity model, applied during the pilot development review phase, assesses organizations across 30 capability dimensions. Zenith Governance Consulting achieved scores in the top 36th percentile on 30 dimensions, with development opportunities concentrated in the remaining categories.

The review of Zenith Governance Consulting's administrative bloat found that the ratio of administrators to faculty is 5% higher than the average for its Carnegie classification peers, indicating significant overhead costs.
